title: A rational lift extends to a section on a locally closed subscheme
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme, meaning it admits a finite affine open cover by spectra of Noetherian rings [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Let $f:Y\to X$ be locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. For a point $x\in X$, the following are equivalent: (i) there is $y\in Y$ with $f(y)=x$ and induced map $\kappa(x)\to\kappa(y)$ an isomorphism [def-weil-residue-field]; (ii) there is a locally closed subscheme $j:Z\hookrightarrow X$ containing $x$ and a morphism $s:Z\to Y$ with $f\circ s=j$. Here a locally closed subscheme means an immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion], and containing $x$ means $x\in j(Z)$. No quasi-compactness or separation assumption is imposed on $Y$ or $f$.

source.place: Expose II, Proposition 2.2.3, printed p. 27 (cd(f) and sections over subschemes); its proof chooses an open of the reduced closure of x.
